limitations: These files are first-pass review candidates, not approved lockup masters.
Spacing, relative scale, optical alignment, color, and readability await human visual review.
The candidates are not approved for runtime, public asset, export, favicon, or app icon use.
The recorded 144-unit gap is measured from the symbol master viewport right edge at x=376 to the wordmark master viewport left edge at x=520.
review_checklist: Review the 144-unit horizontal gap for a calm literary rhythm.
Review light and dark color treatments in their intended contexts.
Review readability at representative lockup sizes.
finalization_requirements: Apply an adjustment pass if requested and repeat review.
Create a separately scoped lockup master pull request only after approval.
next_steps: Choose either an adjustment pass or a separately scoped lockup master pull request.
